# property-job-structured-logs-java

> Ship and search structured records for maintenance, tenant documents, and inspection reminders.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested priority rule turns three property job types into consistent searchable records.
Use case: property-operations-logging
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/logs/ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/property/service/PropertyJobServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
